binary_source_artifact_preference.evidence: Inspected baseline docker_profile.py and compose.yaml plus the scoped diff. Baseline allowed an unconfigured native endpoint bypass and advertised any Linux host without pre-Compose capability admission. Current adds canonical shell admission, explicit endpoint pinning, startup caller guards, existing bind-source refusal, and honest candidate scope. This is a binary SOURCE quality preference, not gate acceptance; current still fails the three findings.
binary_source_artifact_preference.largest_remaining_source_gap: Close the temporary supervisor parent boundary and preserve its declared inputs before creating or operating a unit.

boundary_assessment.capability_and_runtime: Shell checks CPU/memory/swap/pids flags, cgroup v2 controllers, durable mount/access mode, recognized storage/runtime and sysfs whole disk mapping. Python calls the same shell before JSON daemon and exact controller identity/security/mount/checkout validation. The baked contract protects dependency installation and rollback startup boundaries.
boundary_assessment.installer_startup: Inspected install_server daemon/preflight/install/ensure_images/supervise ordering, foreground and worker CLI guards, Runtime constructor, component up, installation up, device/snapshot admission, service template/rendering and container start. Main effects are gated except the temporary supervised_run_check parent boundary above.
boundary_assessment.limits: No actual filesystem metadata persistence, resource enforcement, clean install, reboot, Supabase startup, public registry availability/authentication or complete application recovery was established. SOURCE evidence cannot close those obligations.
boundary_assessment.primary_launcher: Pins explicit local socket, canonical checkout/data root, project, absolute Compose file and /dev/null env file. Startup/build/pull/bootstrap/smoke/upgrade admission precedes Compose operations; observation and cleanup remain usable. Scalar controls and argument shapes fail closed.
boundary_assessment.public_prerequisites_and_support: Primary launcher requires POSIX shell, Docker/Compose and enumerated public Linux utilities. Native optional path retains documented Python/Bun/service account/systemd prerequisites. English and Arabic Docker guides define local Linux x86_64 rootful candidate and explicitly leave support and production unproven. No private workstation prerequisite found in this scoped implementation.

findings.evidence: Actual main() calls systemctl show-environment, creates USER_UNIT_DIR, writes UNIT_PATH, reloads the user manager, and starts the unit without process-level docker_profile admission. An owned-directory reproduction mocked every service and daemon interaction and configured require_supported to refuse architecture_unvalidated. Admission call count remained 0; the unit directory and evidence file were created and mocked daemon-reload/start calls occurred. Its child ExecStartPre admission is later than these effects. This violates R2 and the complete relevant startup boundary.
findings.recommendation: Run the canonical process-level admission immediately after argument validation and before service queries, directory/file creation, or manager mutations; add an owned-tree refusal regression.
findings.reproduction: Import supervised_run_check in an owned TemporaryDirectory; patch USER_UNIT_DIR, UNIT_PATH and EVIDENCE into it; patch systemctl, journal, wait_for_console and owned_running with inert doubles; patch docker_profile.require_supported to raise ProfileError; call main(). Observed admission_calls=0, directory_created=true, evidence_written=true, service calls include daemon-reload and start.
findings.title: Temporary supervisor entrypoint mutates before host admission

findings.evidence: docker_environment only forwards DOCKER_HOST and DOCKER_CONTEXT. With DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/custom.sock, SBARBASE_DOCKER_PROFILE=local-v1, SBARBASE_DOCKER_SOCKET=/run/custom.sock and SBARBASE_DOCKER_DATA_ROOT=/srv/docker, the actual returned mapping contains only DOCKER_HOST. Actual unit_text has no Environment entry for the declared socket or data root. Its first shell guard therefore falls back to /var/run/docker.sock and /var/lib/docker, refusing or inspecting a different declaration from the invoking installation. HOST-PREFLIGHT.md explicitly promises that this mirror retains declared profile/socket/root inputs.
findings.recommendation: After canonical admission, forward the accepted profile, socket and data root with safe systemd scalar serialization and keep the endpoint consistent. Cover nondefault inputs in an inert mirror fixture.
findings.reproduction: Under patch.dict(os.environ, the custom inputs above, clear=True), call docker_environment() and unit_text(). Observed mapping only DOCKER_HOST, contains_declared_socket=false, contains_declared_root=false.
findings.title: Temporary service drops declared profile, socket and daemon root

findings.evidence: The OS check refuses exactly empty strings and Desktop substrings, but accepts whitespace-only OS evidence and the unavailable projection marker <no value>. Independently executed ShellAdmissionTests owned fixtures used actual compose.sh and host-preflight.sh with otherwise valid daemon information. Replacing OperatingSystem with three spaces or <no value> returned 0, emitted the passing preflight diagnostic, and recorded one fake Compose up mutation. Checkout/data-root tree assertions passed, and no actual Docker ran. The code itself calls missing daemon OS evidence outside the candidate scope, and the source contract requires malformed/unavailable observation refusal before mutation.
findings.recommendation: Require meaningful nonplaceholder OS evidence without a distribution allowlist. Replay missing/whitespace/placeholder diagnostics in both host and runtime modes and assert zero mutation.
findings.reproduction: Instantiate ShellAdmissionTests with its owned fake executables, call setUp(), run_shell(["up"], info={"OperatingSystem":"   "}) or info={"OperatingSystem":"<no value>"}, then tearDown(). Observed returncode=0, stderr empty, mutations.jsonl length=1.
findings.title: Unavailable OS observations pass the malformed-record boundary
